speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: Automating the trigger alone leaves the weekly retraining cycle rigid and ignores the compute cost of running it on a fixed schedule. I want a performance based trigger that only fires when drift actually threatens our availability and waste KPIs.
output.correction: You misread my proposal as a simple automation ticket, but I am defining a new operational objective for the system. The goal is to optimize the cost to benefit ratio of retraining, not just remove a manual step from the workflow.
